vetSays.line: A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Thirst doesn't negotiate. Going." Company makes the road shorter.
You catch fragments by the fire — A man, maybe 40s, with freckles telling A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek about A man, maybe 60s. Half of it's true anymore. You're not sure which half.

"Hey." A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek settles near you, not too close. "Day one. Everyone's pretending they're fine. ...Can we talk? Just talk — like people used to." (Talk to A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek.)
A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek shakes their head. "Ask someone who trusts you." (Trust too low.)
A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek folds their arms. "Sure. Your call. For now."
A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek shakes their head. "Ask someone who trusts you." (Trust too low.)
A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek mutters something under their breath. You catch only the last word: "again."
A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek shakes their head. "Ask someone who trusts you." (Trust too low.)
💧 A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +2 clean.
You catch fragments by the fire — A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek telling A woman, maybe 30s, with a farmer's tan about you. It's picking up decorations as it travels.
A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Thirst doesn't negotiate. Going." Good kit is the difference out there.
A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek doesn't say a word. They just stand there, arms crossed, until you finish giving the order. The silence does the talking.
"Enough," A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek says. "I want a say in how this village runs. A real say."
"You haven't earned that yet," A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek says. (Trust too low.)
"Why are YOU giving orders?" A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek doesn't raise their voice. That's worse.
A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek shakes their head. "Ask someone who trusts you." (Trust too low.)
"You haven't earned that yet," A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek says. (Trust too low.)
💧 A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +2 clean.
A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek was watching. Now they know Tiger Nut too.
A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek sets out to find Ray. "Won't be long." Company makes the road shorter.
You catch fragments by the fire — Ray telling A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek about you. Someone's added a flourish that wasn't there this morning.
You catch fragments by the fire — Quinn telling A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek about you. It's picking up decorations as it travels.
🚶 A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek is back — found Ray.

A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek spends the afternoon with the tree with compound leaves and hard nuts — look, smell, the smallest taste, then waiting. An hour passes. Then another. Nothing. The fire nods. That's dinner, maybe.
A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek shakes their head. "Ask someone who trusts you." (Trust too low.)
"You haven't earned that yet," A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek says. (Trust too low.)
A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek doesn't say a word. They just stand there, arms crossed, until you finish giving the order. The silence does the talking.
A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek shakes their head. "Ask someone who trusts you." (Trust too low.)
A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek mutters something under their breath. You catch only the last word: "again."
...and then it lands: A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek speaks 🇷🇺 Russian. You share no language at all.
🛡️ Kevin, Nathan, the person in their 30s, Konstantin and Xavier met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Kevin, the person in their 30s, Konstantin, Xavier are hurt.
🛡️ Kevin, Xavier, Devon and Daniyar met them at the door — 1 put down, 3 driven off. Kevin, Xavier are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Nathan just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Carmen just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Ray, Kevin, Nathan, Carmen and Xavier met them at the door — 3 put down, 2 driven off. Ray, Nathan, Carmen are hurt.
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Carmen just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Kevin just put down Big Loud... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Devon just put down The Focus Group... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Ray, Kevin, Xavier, Devon and Daniyar met them at the door — 5 put down. Ray, Kevin, Daniyar are hurt.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Pavel just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."
🛡️ Pavel met them at the door — 1 put down. Pavel is hurt.
🛡️ Elena and Pavel met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 driven off. Elena, Pavel are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Elena just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
